about_the_game:
Jongevo Live

"Master Fate. The New Era of Mahjong Battles!"

This is an entertainment mahjong battle where you manipulate fate and aim for the top with your favorite characters!

◆ Game Overview

Experience the thrilling “Entertainment Mahjong Mode,” a new take on traditional mahjong that introduces unique skills and unexpected twists! Of course, you can also enjoy classic mahjong play.

Join the action in Jongevo Live, a new era of online mahjong where talented voice actors and VTubers bring the entertainment mahjong battles to life!

◆ Game Highlights

・“Entertainment Mahjong Mode” featuring unique skills and random events for strategic depth beyond classic mahjong

・Star-studded lineup of voice actors and VTubers! Enjoy real-time interaction with your favorites in lively mahjong matches

・Deepen bonds with characters to unlock exclusive voices and outfits

・Host your own online mahjong tournaments with original rules

・Get hyped by watching or joining the official "evo League" and "evo Cup" where your favorite stars shine!

◆ Battle & Spectator Modes

・Private room functionality for easy matches with friends and groups

・Watch official tournaments featuring VTubers and celebrities

◆ Support for Beginners

Expressive internal monologues of the characters enhance the psychological battles, making it easy for newcomers to enjoy.

◆ Characters

A diverse lineup of 36 characters will join you in battle. Enjoy unique mahjong voice lines by a talented cast of voice actors.

Dunamis (Fifth Unit)

Whether you love mahjong, support your favorite characters, or enjoy exciting live streams, Jongevo Live offers mahjong entertainment for everyone!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 class (around 2.0 GHz)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU or NVIDIA® GeForce® GT 1030 equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 650 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 600 MB available space

short_description: Aim for the top in "JongEvo Live," a mahjong game featuring voice actors and VTubers. Use EX skills, react to sudden events, and deepen bonds to unlock voices and outfits. Join tournaments and connect with your favorite performers through live battles. Fun for beginners and pros alike!
